text_block_list.text:
One day, as I passed by the school store, 
an unfamiliar special corner had been set 
up.

Gazing happily at the banners reading 
"Grand Refurbishment!" and "Open for 
Business!" was—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Splendid! What a magnificent result! 
There's no doubt your Trainer will be 
thrilled with this!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Oho? There you are, Trainer <username>! Perfect 
timing, feast your eyes!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of all our esteemed trainers, 
occupying a space in the school store... 
We are grandly!! Open for business!!

*Thwack!* Chairwoman Akikawa points firmly 
toward where the following is written.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative! We generously offer carefully 
selected, handy, and wonderful "Training 
Goods"!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
For the healthy growth of all Umamusume! 
Please, by all means! Put it to good use!

At first, I listened with admiration as 
Chairwoman Akikawa enthusiastically 
explained her products, but—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: ...And so, no cash is needed for shopping!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative! You can purchase them in 
exchange for special shop coins!!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
And! Those coins will be awarded based on 
your performance in the races you run!!

...They're spending way too generously. I 
decided to take the plunge and ask about 
it.
choice_data_list: Um, what about the purchasing funds...?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: C-Chairwomaaan~~?!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Tazuna! I was just explaining the 
Special Shop to the Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I have something to discuss regarding that 
Special Shop!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"Chairwoman... Did you make another 
massive purchase out of your own 
pocket...?!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Mm! I am funding it out of my own pocket!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"And swift, too! The supply route has 
already been established!"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate the thought, but every single 
time the scale is just way too massive...!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Wah-hah-hah-hah! If it is for my beloved 
Umamusume, paying out of my own pocket is 
a mere trifle!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Ah, I'm not finished talking yet~!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: ...It's magnificent!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I was informed about that during 
another interview. Thank you as always for 
your support.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Still, how magnificent...! Chairwoman 
Akikawa's resolve to throw all her 
personal wealth behind the Umamusume!
choice_data_list: No, not necessarily all of it...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
I absolutely have to write an article 
about this!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
"Chairwoman Akikawa, fully prepared to 
give everything for the sake of the 
Twinkle Star Climax..."

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
"And dedicating themselves with all their 
might in response is Trainer <username>!"

Why am I dedicating my own body to this as 
well...?

I gaze out the window while listening to 
Reporter Otonashi's excited voice.

"...Still, being able to freely use the 
special shop from now on is a huge help. 
I'll make the most of whatever I can 
use...!"
